nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, set in the Owned constructor and updated in acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Mapping of token holder address to token balance; written by transfer, transferFrom and the COCCO constructor.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to approved allowance; written by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
Total token supply, fixed at 1000000000000 in the COCCO constructor.
Token symbol string, set to COCCO in the constructor.
Token name string, set to COCCO in the constructor.
Token decimals, set to 5 in the constructor.
SafeMath addition helper that adds two unsigned integers and requires the result not to have wrapped.
SafeMath subtraction helper that requires the subtrahend not to exceed the minuend.
SafeMath multiplication helper that verifies the product divided by the first operand equals the second.
SafeMath division helper that requires a non-zero divisor.
Owner-only function that stages a new owner in newOwner for later acceptance.
Two-step ownership acceptance; requires msg.sender to equal newOwner, then moves ownership and clears newOwner.
Owned constructor which assigns owner = msg.sender at deployment.
COCCO constructor which sets metadata and mints the entire supply to a fixed address.
Returns _totalSupply minus the balance of the zero address.
Returns the token balance of a given token owner.
ERC20 transfer moving tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using SafeMath checks.
ERC20 approval that sets the allowance of a spender for msg.sender without a double-spend guard.
ERC20 transferFrom that debits the from balance and the msg.sender allowance and credits the recipient.
Returns the remaining allowance granted by tokenOwner to spender.
Sets an allowance and then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract, an external callback.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, refusing ETH.
Owner-only function that invokes transfer on an arbitrary token contract to recover stuck tokens.
External interface entry point implemented by spender contracts and invoked by approveAndCall.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance debits and allowance lookups.
Addition c = a + b inside safeAdd, guarded only by require(c >= a).
Subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub, guarded only by require(b <= a).
Multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul together with the division check c / a == b.
Division c = a / b inside safeDiv, guarded only by require(b > 0).
Balance arithmetic in transfer: safeSub on the sender balance followed by safeAdd on the recipient balance.
Balance and allowance arithmetic in transferFrom: safeSub on balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], safeAdd on balances[to].
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) made from approveAndCall to an attacker-supplied contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) made from transferAnyERC20Token to an arbitrary token contract.
Ownership authorization check require(msg.sender == newOwner) in acceptOwnership (and require(msg.sender == owner) via onlyOwner).
First uint operand of the SafeMath helpers safeAdd, safeSub, safeMul and safeDiv.
Second uint operand of the SafeMath helpers safeAdd, safeSub, safeMul and safeDiv.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a is a transient operand of the arithmetic performed inside safeAdd and carries no independent persistent state.
Parameter b is a transient operand of the arithmetic performed inside safeAdd and carries no independent persistent state.
tokenOwner is only a lookup key used by balanceOf to read the balances mapping.
spender is only a lookup key used by approve when writing the allowed mapping.
to is only the credit destination index used by transfer on the balances mapping.
tokens is the transient amount moved by transfer before being written into balances.
from is only the debit index used by transferFrom on the balances and allowed mappings.
data is an opaque payload forwarded by approveAndCall and holds no contract state.
_newOwner is immediately copied into the newOwner state variable by transferOwnership.
tokenAddress is only the external call target supplied to transferAnyERC20Token.
The named return variable balance is a temporary carrier for the value read by balanceOf.
The named return variable remaining is a temporary carrier for the value read by allowance.
Local c exists only to hold the addition result produced inside safeAdd.
Local c exists only to hold the subtraction result produced inside safeSub.
Local c exists only to hold the multiplication result produced inside safeMul.
